debug_mode.description: Enable verbose debug logging for the meinchat backend plugin (live mode when off)

max_message_length.description: Maximum number of characters allowed in a single chat message

image_max_size_bytes.description: Maximum allowed image attachment size in bytes (default: 5 MB)

messages_retention_days_server.description: How many days the server keeps message rows before pruning. 0 = server-amnesic (every message deleted on the next cron tick). NOTE: incompatible with `meinchat-plus` enabled — async first-message delivery via prekey bundles requires the server to hold ciphertext until delivery. The plugin loader refuses to enable meinchat-plus while this key is 0.

messages_retention_days_client_suggested.description: Suggested client-side retention (days). Well-behaved clients shorten but never extend beyond this value (best-effort UX default — not a security guarantee; a forked client can ignore it).

attachments_retention_days_server.description: Server-side retention for attachment objects, read by the S28.1 attachment prune. Same E2E-exemption semantics as messages.

ciphertext_max_bytes.description: Upper bound on message envelope size in bytes (ciphertext + per-recipient fan-out header + padding). Validates server-side in S28.3b's SignalEnvelopeValidator.

retention_prune_cron.description: 5-field crontab (UTC) for the daily server-retention prune (S28.1). Default 03:00 UTC. The job hard-deletes message rows older than `messages_retention_days_server` plus their attachment objects.

sse_max_stream_seconds.description: Server-side lifetime cap (seconds) for each SSE stream. When reached the stream closes and the browser's EventSource auto-reconnects — prevents an idle connection from pinning a gunicorn worker/DB connection indefinitely (S-incident fix).

event_bus_backend.description: SSE fan-out backend (S38). 'redis' = require Redis, fail loud if unreachable (recommended for multi-worker prod). 'auto' = prefer Redis, warn and degrade to the single-worker in-process bus if Redis is down (dev-friendly). 'memory' = always in-process (correct only with GUNICORN_WORKERS=1).

event_bus_channel_prefix.description: Redis pub/sub channel namespace prefix for SSE fan-out (S38). The per-worker listener psubscribes '<prefix>*'; keep it unique to meinchat so the pattern cannot catch foreign channels.

rate_new_conversation_per_window.description: Baseline: max new-conversation creations per rolling window (web + unknown platforms). Counter increments only when a brand-new conversation row is created — opening an existing chat is free.

rate_new_conversation_window_seconds.description: Baseline: rolling window length in seconds for new_conversation.

rate_nickname_search_per_window.description: Baseline: max nickname-search calls per rolling window.

rate_nickname_search_window_seconds.description: Baseline: rolling window length in seconds for nickname_search.

rate_message_send_per_window.description: Baseline: max messages sent per rolling window.

rate_message_send_window_seconds.description: Baseline: rolling window length in seconds for message_send.

rate_attachment_send_per_window.description: Baseline: max attachment uploads per rolling window.

rate_attachment_send_window_seconds.description: Baseline: rolling window length in seconds for attachment_send.

rate_ios_new_conversation_per_window.description: iOS override: max new-conversation creations per rolling window when X-Client-Platform: ios.

rate_ios_new_conversation_window_seconds.description: iOS override: rolling window length in seconds for new_conversation.

rate_ios_nickname_search_per_window.description: iOS override: max nickname-search calls per rolling window.

rate_ios_nickname_search_window_seconds.description: iOS override: rolling window length in seconds for nickname_search.

rate_ios_message_send_per_window.description: iOS override: max messages sent per rolling window.

rate_ios_message_send_window_seconds.description: iOS override: rolling window length in seconds for message_send.

rate_ios_attachment_send_per_window.description: iOS override: max attachment uploads per rolling window.

rate_ios_attachment_send_window_seconds.description: iOS override: rolling window length in seconds for attachment_send.

guest_economy_enabled.description: S86.3 D11 (word-based): when on, a public bot-widget guest is granted initial tokens on activation and spends them per word (questions AND bot answers, 1 token = 1 word). When off, no grant and no metering (guest chats are free).

guest_initial_tokens.description: S86.3 D11: tokens credited to a freshly provisioned widget guest on activation. Granted only to a NEW guest — a returning guest reusing its session is not re-granted.

guest_token_cost_per_word.description: S86.3 D11 (REVISED, word-based billing): tokens charged per word. Both the guest's question words and the bot's answer words are debited from the guest (1 token = 1 word by default). 0 disables per-word charging.

guest_charge_bot_answers.description: S86.3 D11: when on (default, today's behavior) the guest is charged per word for EVERY message in its widget room, including the bot's answer words. When off, the guest is charged only for the words it authored — the bot's reply is free. Useful for sales/consultant bots whose long pitch should not drain the prospect's balance.

buy_tokens_href.description: URL the bot-widget's out-of-tokens "Buy tokens" button links to (the token-bundles / pricing page).
